paper_title: List Decoding Bounds for Binary Codes with Noiseless Feedback
statement: In this paper, we investigate the analogous question for feedback codes, first posed in [30]. In a feedback code, what is the maximum fraction r of adversarial errors such that Bob can always learn a list of size ℓ containing Alice’s message? We denote such a code as a (ℓ, r)-list decodable feedback code. In our work, we provide the first non-trivial unconditional lower and upper bounds for this question.
